name: scroll-world
title_zh: 滚动即飞行，一镜到底穿过整个微缩世界
tagline_zh: 访客滚动，镜头从场景外飞进室内再滑向下一幕，全程无剪辑。预渲染相机路径，任何行业落地页都能变成一场连续飞行。
tagline_en: As visitors scroll, the camera flies from outside into each scene and glides to the next—no cuts. Pre-rendered.
desc_en: Build an immersive scroll-scrubbed "fly through the world" landing page for any industry or brand using Higgsfield. As the visitor scrolls, a pre-rendered camera flies from outside each scene into its interior, then flows on to the next scene with NO cuts — one continuous connected flight (Emons-style isometric diorama world, or any art direction you pick). why_zh: 别人做滚动动画是逐帧硬切，它用预渲染相机路径把多个场景缝成一次无断点飞行。
why_en: Others cut frame-by-frame; this stitches scenes into one seamless pre-rendered camera flight. Emons-style isometric or your own.
limit_zh: 依赖 Higgsfield 预渲染，需先装其 CLI 并备好 GPU 或云端额度；只产出镜头路径与场景衔接脚本。
limit_en: Requires Higgsfield CLI + GPU/cloud quota for pre-rendering. Outputs camera paths and scene-stitch scripts only—no 3D assets included; bring your.
title_en: Scroll to fly through a seamless diorama world
